lede: Oklahoma carries the stronger underlying team rating — +11.1 against +2.5, a 8.6-point separation on a neutral field before home advantage, travel or rest.
EdgeDesk makes it Florida −2.0 before any sportsbook number is consulted, with Florida winning 55% of simulations.
The position-group comparison shows where the separation comes from: the widest measured gap is depth, where Florida leads Oklahoma by 115 places nationally.
Data confidence on this matchup is 75% — high by this board’s standards, so the margin is the strongest part of the read.
